plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.title: Contract and Invoice Providers
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.descripti: Tencent eSign and Nuonuo use the merchant's own accounts, applications and billing. This page stores protected configuration and reports whether real provider calls are actually ready.
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.notice: Configuration and real readiness are shown separately
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.ready.des: Protected credentials, merchant subject and the reviewed API gate are all ready.
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.blocked.t: Real provider service is not ready
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.blocked.e: The formal Nuonuo API, buyer account and verifiable calling contract still require external confirmation. Configuration can be stored safely, but the system will not pretend an invoice was issued.
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.blocked.o: The Tencent API contract is reviewed, but valid credentials and a bound merchant subject are still required.
plugin.idc-compliance.supplier.credentia: The content is sent only to server-side secret storage. It is never displayed again or written to audit evidence. A recent full sign-in is required.
Enter a provider credential envelope of at least 16 characters.
The provider credential was stored securely.
plugin.idc-compliance.name: IDC Compliance
plugin.idc-compliance.description: Identity verification, enterprise review, electronic contracts, tax invoicing, and compliance evidence.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.title: Aliyun Identity Provider
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.subtitle: Connect this installation to the IDC merchant's own Aliyun financial-grade identity account. Credentials remain server-side, connectivity checks never start an identity flow, and interrupted updates fail closed.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.status.co: No credential is active. Complete the guided setup before customer identity flows are enabled.
The last replacement did not complete locally. No credential is enabled until safe recovery succeeds.
The current secret generation is available to the server-side FACE adapter.
New customer identity flows are blocked while historical evidence remains readable.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.status.va: Run a read-only signed query after configuration. It does not initialize authentication.
The signed query reached the configured FACE product and scene.
Aliyun rejected the credential, product entitlement, or scene configuration.
The provider or network result was ambiguous. No configuration state was guessed.
Endpoint, protocol, service, product, and identity mode are fixed in code. Staff cannot redirect identity data to another host.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.actions.d: Credential changes and connectivity checks require a full host sign-in within the last five minutes.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.responsib: The IDC merchant owns this account and its usage cost
The merchant operating this installed system enters its own Aliyun RAM credential and pays Aliyun directly. End customers never configure, view, or pay this technical account.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.form.desc: Enter the numeric FACE scene ID and one RAM AccessKey pair from the merchant's Aliyun account. The pair is consumed as one secret envelope and is never returned.
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.form.scen: Numeric scene ID from the Aliyun console
Enter a numeric scene ID up to 64 digits
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.form.acce: Enter the merchant's RAM AccessKey ID
plugin.idc-compliance.provider.form.reau: For protection against unattended sessions, the API accepts this action only within five minutes of a full sign-in. Sign in again if the session is older.
Re-enter the intended credential pair. The server uses its retained operation key to create, replace, or safely replay the exact secret mutation before enabling the configuration.
The previous request was interrupted. Customer identity flows remain disabled until an authorized operator re-enters the intended credential and recovery completes.
The already completed secret mutation was safely reused
